installation_scope: Installed wheel outside checkout, existing system dependencies, no downloads.

correctness.requirement: Every complete token sequence and length must match, with original budgets and EOS behavior.

compact.acceptance_metric: Total accepted draft tokens divided by total proposed draft tokens.
compact.completion_gate: All full outputs match HF and aggregate held-out acceptance is higher after training than at initialization.
compact.uncertainty: Report 2000 paired family-cluster bootstrap resamples (8 fixed test families), seed 17, 95% percentile interval for the acceptance difference; one training seed only.

timing.selection_rule: First lexicographically sorted ID for every test family and original generation budget.
timing.baseline: Observed fastest of the three target-only references, separately for aggregate, each workload and each budget.
timing.weights: Equal weight for each family-budget cell; does not use the original split's unequal budget frequencies.
timing.order: Seeded prompt permutations per repeat; method order rotates and alternates direction as implemented in benchmarks.timing.
timing.scope: Generation plus output decoding; loading, tokenization, correctness and warm-up excluded. GPU timing has explicit device barriers. Phase profiling is separate.
timing.intervals: 2000 paired bootstrap resamples of repeat means; 95% percentile intervals conditional on these fixed cases and the observed fastest baseline.
timing.speed_target_gate: For each device, all correctness checks pass and the aggregate 95% speedup interval's lower bound is at least 1.25. Report every workload and budget, including regressions.
timing.generalization_limit: Procedural decoding workloads, one local target and machine; not answer-quality or broad deployment benchmarks.

freeze_scope: Locally frozen before test inference; not an externally preregistered protocol.

bench_cuda_attempt_1.message: Stopped for runtime during profiling. Numeric timings were not saved and are not included in the reported estimates.

retry.change_scope: Timing persistence and post-timing output-hash checks; inference, measured methods and experimental settings unchanged.
retry.reason: The earlier attempt was interrupted before its numeric timing report was written.

execution.selection: Settings, prompts, budgets and seeds were fixed before test inference. No test-based tuning or score-based retries were performed.
execution.expansion: Negative validation results did not justify learned-policy held-out timing, more failure-mask training, or three-seed studies.
execution.wall_time: CPU benchmark completed in about 84 minutes. GPU retry completed in 86.61 minutes; its earlier attempt stopped during profiling after about 51 minutes.
